defuss-shadcn / Website / website-industries

Industries

One-page sites for eight kinds of business, made of the same components and website blocks - each with its own palette, type and three looks, and everything on it working: the bookings, the filters, the calculators, the dialogs.

On this page (2)
What each site carriesThe sites

§What each site carries

The Showcase method, applied to businesses whose sites have a job to do:

  • The task the visitor came for, working - a table booked for a slot the kitchen serves, a price for your hair length, the nights of a stay with the city tax, an appointment request beside the emergency numbers, a deadline counted to the day.
  • A detail only this business has - allergen codes, processing times, room sizes in m², the out-of-hours number, sauna temperatures, the statutory fees, the weeks of a project, prices per million tokens.
  • A Site Header and a Site Footer - the navigation jumps to the sections, the footer holds the address, the hours and working imprint and privacy dialogs.
  • Three looks, each in light and dark - the Look select and the light / dark switch in the header.

§The sites

Restaurant

Taula Llarga: a Catalan restaurant round one long table - a menu you filter by allergen, tonight on a slanted chalkboard, a booking form that knows the kitchen's hours. Terracotta, Candlelight, Terrace.

Hair Salon

Juniper & Shear: prices that change with your hair length and the stylist's level, colour processing times, free slots per stylist, a balayage before and after. Salon, Neon, Botanical.

Hotel

Hotel Ebbstein: fourteen rooms in a net loft on a Baltic quay - a search that prices every room for your nights with the city tax, rooms in m² with a photo viewer. Harbour, Linen, Night.

Doctor

Praxis am Kastanienhof: a family practice - open or closed now from its hours and holidays, appointments beside the emergency numbers, repeat prescriptions, step-free access. Clinic, Warm, High contrast.

Spa

Salt & Cedar: a day spa in a 1912 bathhouse - treatments in minutes behind a filter, booking with a therapist, a voucher that fills in as you type, every room from 12 to 90 °C. Stone, Eucalyptus, Night bath.

Legal Advisor

Lindholm & Kaya: employment and tenancy law - a deadline check that counts the three weeks, each lawyer's profile, the fees stated plainly. Chambers, Modern, Paper.

Agency

Loud/Quiet: a brand and digital studio - cases that open with the number they moved, a 16-week project week by week, open jobs, a brief that estimates as you tick. Studio, Brutal, Pastel.

AI Startup

Quillon: an API that turns meetings into decisions and action items - a replayed demo, p50 / p95 latency, a 400k-token context, prices per 1M tokens. Launch, Terminal, Research.

Every site opens full screen from its page; the front page's Website Templates view lists them with the other sites.
